Severe text for high-priority warnings

Foreground table values: --fgColor-attention #9a6700 (yellow), --fgColor-severe #bc4c00 (orange), --fgColor-danger #d1242f (red). Severe sits between the warning (attention) and danger tokens; the page gives no prose definition.
Light orange.5 #bc4c00, dark orange.4 #db6d28; a stronger warning than the attention base, so the mapping needs strong emphasis, not just warning.

verdicts.note: Warning with strong emphasis follows the ADR 0012 warning ladder (Carbon caution-major). ADR 0008 names intent-caution broad for severity between warning and danger; the description says high-priority warnings, so the warning ladder fits better.
